seo.title: Industries Served — Aerospace, Space, Medical, Food & Beverage
seo.description: Control panels, automation machines and wire harnesses for aerospace and defense, space and launch, entertainment and theme parks, medical device, food and beverage, semiconductor and industrial OEM customers — with the standards, flowdowns and documentation each one requires.

sections.title:
We can't show you
their logos. Here's
*everything else*.
sections.text: Most of our customers work under supply agreements that don't permit vendors to display their marks — which is fairly standard once you're building for aerospace, space, and defense programs. We'd rather respect that than decorate a page. So instead of a logo wall, here is what we actually do, for whom, and what it took to be approved to do it.

sections._editorNote: Replace each reference line with your real work. Keep them unnamed but specific — a description a buyer can decode is worth more than a logo they scroll past.
sections.heading: Industries we build for
sections.intro: Each of these imposes a different requirement on the build. The industry doesn't just describe who buys — it determines the standard, the documentation, and the inspection level.

items.label: Market 01
items.title: Aerospace & Defense

items.reference: Class 3 harnesses and functional test equipment for tier-one aerospace suppliers.

sections.heading: Also building for

A logo proves someone
bought something once
sections.intro: What actually tells you whether a supplier is any good is the bar they had to clear to get on the approved vendor list — and whether they're still on it years later. Getting approved by an aerospace or space customer is not a purchase order. It's an audit, a quality system review, and a first article process, and you can be removed from the list at any time. That's the part worth knowing about us.

columns.label: Proof 01
columns.title: We pass customer audits
columns.text: Our quality system has been audited on site by customers in aerospace, space, and medical device — and we're still supplying all of them.

columns.label: Proof 02
columns.title: We handle the flowdowns
columns.text: The requirements your customer pushes onto you get pushed onto us, and we're set up to absorb them rather than ask for exceptions.

columns.label: Proof 03
columns.title: They keep coming back
columns.text: The strongest signal we can give you honestly. Nobody re-qualifies a supplier every year for a decade unless the parts keep arriving right.

sections.note: References available on request — several customers who can't be named publicly will take a call.

sections._editorNote: Shot list for a half-day shop photo session: open panel shot straight on; harness board mid-build; machine on the floor with guarding and HMI; Hoffman ModCenter machining an enclosure; technician crimping or inspecting; finished panel bank before crating. Blur customer nameplates and legend text where required.
sections.heading: Show the work instead
sections.intro: A controls engineer can judge craftsmanship from a photograph in about four seconds. Dressed wire, straight DIN rail, consistent labeling, clean harness boards — that's evidence no competitor can borrow.

sections.heading: Not sure which of the three you need?
sections.intro: Plenty of customers come to us for one capability and end up using two or three. Tell us what you're trying to build and we'll tell you which parts we'd handle — including the parts we wouldn't.
